NANOLITE / PROJECT SUPPORT

Good questions.
Considered answers.

Ask about materials, manufacturing equipment or the details of your project.

Start here.

Which material is right for my wall?

CLC blocks and precast panels serve different construction applications. Share your drawings and intended use so our team can discuss the appropriate material and specifications.

Can CLC replace the structural frame?

The materials featured here are selected within a project-designed building system. Structural suitability and loads need review by your project engineer.

How is ReadyMix supplied?

The website lists ReadyMix in 40 kg bags. Tell us the quantity and delivery location so the team can confirm availability, freight and tax.

How do I choose a manufacturing plant?

Share your site layout, intended output and operating requirements. Our team can discuss portable and installed systems and the support needed for your plans.

Where can I find technical documents?

The document library contains the supplied company profile and product catalogue. Ask our team for project-specific technical data.

Nanolite Establishment Consortium

Established in 2010, Nanolite is a leading innovator in the construction industry, specializing in Cellular Lightweight Concrete (CLC) solutions. We stand out for our ability to offer customized CLC blocks tailored to client specifications, including size, PSI, thermal insulation, and weight.

Pre Cast Pannels (PCP) Precast concrete insulated wall panels are designed for use in many interior/exterior and load bearing or non-load bearing building applications and provide a professional finished look as well as increased thermal properties.

Lightweight Concrete (CLC)




Nanolite Cellular Lightweight Concrete (CLC) is an advanced
construction material offering excellent thermal insulation, sound
reduction, fire resistance, and reduced structural loads. Its
lightweight nature makes transportation, handling, and installation
easier while improving overall construction efficiency.

Nano Hybrid Wall System




The Nano Hybrid Wall System is an innovative wall construction
solution developed to reduce construction time while improving
insulation and overall building performance. Nanolite CLC is
poured into the wall cavity, creating a solid insulated wall that
requires minimal finishing after curing..

Precast Panels (PCP)




Nanolite Precast Panels are factory-manufactured wall panels
designed to accelerate construction while maintaining exceptional
quality and dimensional accuracy. These insulated panels reduce
on-site labor, improve thermal performance, and provide a
smooth finished surface ready for installation.

Nanolite Permeable Concrete®




Nanolite Permeable Concrete is a porus concrete solution
designed to allow rainwater to pass through the surface naturally,
reducing water runoff and helping recharge groundwater. It
supports environmentally responsible construction while providing
a durable surface for pedestrian and light-traffic applications.

Nanolite CLC Pouring




Nanolite CLC Pouring is a specialized service designed for projects
that require lightweight concrete to be placed directly on-site.
Using our proprietary Nano ReadyMix®, Nanolite Foaming Agent,
and advanced mixing equipment, our trained team produces
fresh Cellular Lightweight Concrete and pumps it directly into the
required area with speed and precision.

Nanolite Insulated Roof Tiles




Nanolite Insulated Roof Tiles combine lightweight construction with
advanced thermal insulation to improve indoor comfort and
reduce energy consumption. Their innovative design helps lower
heat transfer while placing significantly less weight on the building
structure than conventional roofing systems..

Lightweight Concrete (CLC)
Nanolite Cellular Lightweight Concrete (CLC) is an advanced
construction material offering excellent thermal insulation, sound
reduction, fire resistance, and reduced structural loads. Its
lightweight nature makes transportation, handling, and installation
easier while improving overall construction efficiency.
Nano Hybrid Wall System
The Nano Hybrid Wall System is an innovative wall construction
solution developed to reduce construction time while improving
insulation and overall building performance. Nanolite CLC is
poured into the wall cavity, creating a solid insulated wall that
requires minimal finishing after curing..
Precast Panels (PCP)
Nanolite Precast Panels are factory-manufactured wall panels
designed to accelerate construction while maintaining exceptional
quality and dimensional accuracy. These insulated panels reduce
on-site labor, improve thermal performance, and provide a
smooth finished surface ready for installation.
Nanolite Permeable Concrete®
Nanolite Permeable Concrete is a porus concrete solution
designed to allow rainwater to pass through the surface naturally,
reducing water runoff and helping recharge groundwater. It
supports environmentally responsible construction while providing
a durable surface for pedestrian and light-traffic applications.
Nanolite CLC Pouring
Nanolite CLC Pouring is a specialized service designed for projects
that require lightweight concrete to be placed directly on-site.
Using our proprietary Nano ReadyMix®, Nanolite Foaming Agent,
and advanced mixing equipment, our trained team produces
fresh Cellular Lightweight Concrete and pumps it directly into the
required area with speed and precision.
Nanolite Insulated Roof Tiles
Nanolite Insulated Roof Tiles combine lightweight construction with
advanced thermal insulation to improve indoor comfort and
reduce energy consumption. Their innovative design helps lower
heat transfer while placing significantly less weight on the building
structure than conventional roofing systems..
